tasks.title: Add runtime storage permission request (READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE / READ_MEDIA_IMAGES)
tasks.desc: Request storage permission before benchmark runs. Handle Android 13+ (READ_MEDIA_IMAGES) and older versions (READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE). Show rationale dialog if denied.

tasks.title: Save logs and results to external storage (Downloads folder)
tasks.desc: Modify FileLogger to write to external storage (public Downloads) after permission granted. Keep internal storage fallback. Add method to export/view log file.

tasks.title: Fix model download reliability (add fallback, timeout, retry)
tasks.desc: GitHub raw URLs can be blocked. Add timeout, retry logic, and bundled model fallback or alternative URL.

tasks.title: Improve GPU delegate error handling and device compatibility
tasks.desc: Better detect GPU delegate support. Gracefully handle devices without GPU delegate. Log detailed compatibility info.

tasks.title: Add 'View Logs' button and log export to UI
tasks.desc: Add button to open log file in external viewer. Add 'Copy logs' and 'Share logs' options for debugging.

tasks.title: Add global crash handler with persistent crash logs
tasks.desc: Ensure uncaught exceptions are written to external storage log before app dies. Add crash log viewing in UI.
